risks.title: Cybersecurity and technology dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on its information systems and those of third parties to operate and protect sensitive patient data. Cyber threats are continuously evolving and a breach could have severe consequences on business activities, financial position and operations

risks.title: Evolving regulatory environment
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a heavily regulated environment with risks related to anti-kickback laws, corporate practice of medicine and telemedicine regulations that vary by jurisdiction

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The optical market is highly competitive and fragmented. The company must maintain competitiveness while navigating margin pressures

risks.title: Macroeconomics
risks.score_rationale: Unfavorable macroeconomic environment with inflation, elevated interest rates and declining consumer confidence could impact sales and the company's financial position

risks.title: Geopolitics
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to geopolitical risks, political uncertainties and socio-economic tensions that could impact its operations

risks.title: Telemedicine and state regulations
risks.score_rationale: Telemedicine regulations vary significantly across jurisdictions. Some states restrict or prohibit the use of telemedicine for eye exams by optometrists

ai_positioning.summary: EYE is progressively integrating AI and technology solutions into its strategy. The CTO joined the company in September 2025 with specialized expertise in Agentic AI and cloud solutions, indicating growing recognition of the importance of AI for future technology operations
evidence: CTO appointed September 2025 with expertise in Agentic AI, cloud solutions and enterprise software
Technology infrastructure modernization efforts underway with focus on data and technology strategy
